 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY

Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to add the informant as opposite party no.2.
2. Permission is accorded.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to add the informant as opposite party no.2 during the course of the day.
4. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

5. The present application has been filed by the petitioner invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court for quashing the order dated 25.11.2024 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffarpur in Shyampur Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.10485 of 2025(2)
dt.05-02-2026 Bhataha P.S. Case No.124 of 2021 by which discharge petition of the petitioner was rejected, in a case wherein cognizance for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506,
120(B), 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Bihar Protection Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishment) Act, 2002 has been taken against the petitioner.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was not a named accused in the FIR lodged by the informant.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to the newly added opposite party no. 2 through registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process with present and correct address for which requisite etc. must be filed within one week.

8. Put up this case on 25.03.2026 after appearance of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.10485 of 2025(2) dt.05-02-2026 the opposite party no. 2 or on receipt of service of notice, whichever is earlier, at 02:15 P.M.
9.
